newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy employers favour 1,050 ERM lira/mark level.
newsitem.headline: Italy employers favour 1,050 ERM lira/mark level.

text.p: A reasonable level for the lira's return to the European exchange rate mechanism would be around 1,050 lire per mark, said Innocenzo Cipolletta, director-general of the Italian employer body Confindustria.
"We think that the parity could be around 1,050 lire per mark, more reasonable than the current market level," he told reporters while attending an insurance seminar.
He said that the current lira/mark level was influenced by too high Italian interest rates. At 1405 GMT the lira was quoted at 990.65/0.95 against the mark.

"The lira rate should be set by the market on condition that it is not protected by too high rates." he said, adding that if Italian interest rates were at the same level as its partners then the lira rate would be at a more appropriate level. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
